publications.name: DALSCLIP: Domain Adaptive Language-Image Pre-training for Text-to-Image Generation
publications.summary: We propose a simple yet effective framework called DALSCLIP to achieve high-performance generalization of CLIP, Contrastive LanguageImage Pre-training, in DG. Specifically, we optimize CLIP in two aspects: images and prompts.

publications.name: Establishing Two-Dimensional Dependencies for Multi-Label Image Classification
publications.summary: We propose a Two-Dimensional Dependency Model (TDDM) for MLIC. The network consists of an Spatial Feature Dependency Module (SFDM) and a Label Semantic Dependency Module (LSDM), which establish effective dependencies in the dimensions of image spatial features and label semantics, respectively.
